completed: Implemented paper Algorithms 1-6 independently without posterior grids and executed 6400 trials.
equivalence_status: Core equation reproduction completed; no proof of equivalence to an exact Bayesian posterior or the full author implementation.
normal_limit: Initial noninformative Normal prior and literal zero-variance limit: endpoint observations can collapse uncertainty; 433 amplitude trials encountered zero posterior variance. This is measured failure, not convergence reliability.
beta_limit: Algorithm6 uses 1000 posterior draws and Beta MLE; finite-R approximation and transformed-family misspecification remain.
scheduler_limit: Standard largest legal odd-K schedule is permitted by paper Section3.1, but differs from the author code coarser decrement. Random interval audit found 121/1000 differing scheduler outputs (subset with author output within cap); not a byte-equivalent reproduction. Author deterministic transform agrees within 2.77e-14.
comparison_limit: IQAE-CP shares cumulative-stage observations and scheduler with paper Normal/Beta. Grid retains original update/scheduler and per-round alpha policy, so observed savings do not isolate Bayesian updating or establish equal-error quantum advantage.
noise_limit: All measurements are actual finite-shot ideal Bernoulli simulations; no noisy hardware result.
risk_conclusion: Paper Beta achieves 100/100 five-bp successes at both risk levels on the fixed trained-model discrete task; Normal falls to 87/100 and 50/100 and has substantial undercoverage.
amplitude_conclusion: At 10 shots per batch, Beta success 99.286%, coverage 98.286%, average A calls1283.87; matched-schedule IQAE-CP success99.857%, coverage99.429%,1609.53 calls. Normal success44%,coverage41.286%. At256shots Beta and IQAE-CP both100% success, Beta8588.43calls vs IQAE8332.43; no uniform Beta advantage.
audit: 76310 measurement rounds, zero query accounting mismatches, zero reconstructed branch violations; analytic Normal checked by quadrature, delta variance by finite differences, Beta MLE score max5.75e-10.
